# Rajalakshmi Kalyana Mandapam

> A fully air-conditioned, vegetarian-only mandapam for up to 800 guests, with 11 guest rooms included in the rent, on Velachery Main Road.

Website: https://rajalakshmikalyanamandapam.com/
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 98405 45585

## Contact
- Rajalakshmi Kalyana Mandapam · No. 205/1, Velachery Main Road, Dhandeeswaram, Velachery, Chennai 600 042 · +91 98405 45585 · 044 2243 5353 · 044 4862 5585 · info@rajalakshmikalyanamandapam.com

## Key facts
- 800 guests in the main hall
- 252 seats in the A/C dining hall
- 11 guest rooms included in the rent
- 50 cars parked, plus 100+ two-wheelers

## Facilities
- Centralised A/C hall & dining
- Oonjal available
- 2 lifts for guests + 1 service lift
- 2 generators
- Modern kitchen
- Vessels, tables & chairs
- Vegetarian only
- Parking for 50 cars
- Corporate events & exhibitions

## Frequently asked questions

### How many guests can Rajalakshmi Kalyana Mandapam hold?
Rajalakshmi's main hall takes up to 800 guests, and the A/C dining hall seats up to 252.

### Where is Rajalakshmi Kalyana Mandapam?
No. 205/1, Velachery Main Road, Dhandeeswaram, Velachery, Chennai 600 042.

### What facilities does Rajalakshmi Kalyana Mandapam have?
Centralised A/C hall & dining, Oonjal available, 2 lifts for guests + 1 service lift, 2 generators, Modern kitchen, Vessels, tables & chairs, Vegetarian only, Parking for 50 cars, Corporate events & exhibitions.

### Are rooms included?
Yes. 11 guest rooms are included in the rent, and 4 more are available at additional cost.

### Is non-vegetarian food allowed?
No. Only vegetarian food is allowed.

### How do I check if Rajalakshmi Kalyana Mandapam is free on my date?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 98405 45585.
